title_en: A Handful of Wormwood That Saved Millions
english_paragraphs: Project 523, a covert military mission involving many institutes, was named after its launch date, 23 May 1967. Its urgent target was the chloroquine-resistant malaria weakening troops in the Vietnam War. In January 1969 Tu Youyou was entrusted with leading her institute's research group, despite having no doctorate or foreign training.

In an exhaustive search, her team combed over 2,000 folk recipes, compiled 640 prescriptions, and evaluated about 380 extracts from some 200 medicinal herbs. Qinghao, or sweet wormwood, showed flashes of promise, yet its results were erratic. Seeking a clue, Tu revisited the classical texts.

Around AD 340, the physician Ge Hong's handbook advised taking "a handful of qinghao immersed in two litres of water". This bypassed boiling. Tu suspected heat during extraction was degrading a delicate component, so she switched to ether, a volatile solvent boiling at about 35 degrees Celsius. On 4 October 1971 sample 191 completely inhibited the parasite in infected mice.

Efficacy in mice indicated nothing about human safety. In July 1972, to assess its toxicity, Tu and two colleagues voluntarily took the extract. Thereafter, from August to October, it was administered to 21 malaria patients in Hainan, and on 8 November her team obtained pure crystals of the substance later named artemisinin.

In September 2011 Tu was named a Lasker Award recipient; its jury credited the drug with saving millions. On 5 October 2015 she won half the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, the first Chinese woman Nobel laureate. Since 2006 WHO guidelines have endorsed artemisinin-based combination therapies against malaria's deadliest form. The essence of Ge Hong's line lay in the boiling it skipped.
chinese_source_paragraphs: 523项目是一项**秘密的/隐秘的**(covert)**军事**(military)**任务**(mission)，涉及多家机构，得名于它的启动日期，1967年5月23日。它的**紧迫**(urgent)目标是对氯喹**产生耐药性的**(resistant)**疟疾**(malaria)，它**削弱了**(weakening)**越南战争**(Vietnam War)中的**部队**(troops)。1969年1月，屠呦呦**受命**(entrusted with)领导她所在研究所的研究组，**尽管**(despite)她既没有**博士学位**(doctorate)，也没有在国外受过训练。

在一次**彻底的**(exhaustive)搜寻中，她的团队**仔细翻检了**(combed)2,000多个**民间**(folk)药方，**编纂/汇编了**(compiled)640个**处方/药方**(prescriptions)，并**评估了**(evaluated)约380种**提取物**(extracts)，它们来自200种左右的**药用的**(medicinal)**草药**(herbs)。青蒿，也就是**黄花蒿**(sweet wormwood)，展现出几丝**成功迹象**(promise)的**闪光/闪现**(flashes)，然而它的效果却**并不稳定/时好时坏的**(erratic)。为了寻找**线索**(clue)，屠呦呦**重新审阅了**(revisited)**古典**(classical)文献。

约公元340年，医师葛洪的**手册**(handbook)建议服用：“一把**浸泡在**(immersed in)两**升**(litres)水中的青蒿”。这个方法**绕开了**(bypassed)煮沸。屠呦呦怀疑，**提取**(extraction)过程中的高温正在**降解/分解**(degrading)某种**脆弱的**(delicate)**成分**(component)，于是她**改用/换成了**(switched to)**乙醚**(ether)，一种**易挥发的**(volatile)**溶剂**(solvent)，沸点为约35**摄氏度**(degrees Celsius)。1971年10月4日，第191号样品完全**抑制了**(inhibited)**受感染**(infected)小鼠体内的**寄生虫**(parasite)。

在小鼠身上有**药效**(Efficacy)，并不能**说明**(indicated)人是否安全。1972年7月，为了**评估**(assess)它的**毒性**(toxicity)，屠呦呦和两名同事**自愿地**(voluntarily)服下了这种提取物。**此后**(Thereafter)，从8月到10月，这种提取物**用于治疗**(administered to)21名疟疾**病人**(patients)，在海南，而在11月8日，她的团队**得到了**(obtained)这种**物质**(substance)的纯净**晶体**(crystals)，它后来被命名为青蒿素。

2011年9月，屠呦呦被评为拉斯克奖**得主**(recipient)；该奖的**评审团**(jury)将挽救了数百万人的功劳归功于这种药物。2015年10月5日，她获得了一半的诺贝尔**生理学**(Physiology)或医学奖，成为第一位中国女性诺贝尔奖**获得者**(laureate)。自2006年起，世界卫生组织的**指南**(guidelines)一直**公开支持/赞同**(endorsed)以青蒿素为基础的**联合**(combination)**疗法**(therapies)，用来对付疟疾中**最致命的**(deadliest)一种。葛洪那句话的**精髓**(essence)，正在于它**略去**(skipped)的煮沸。

sentences.english: In January 1969 Tu Youyou was entrusted with leading her institute's research group, despite having no doctorate or foreign training.
sentences.chinese_source: 1969年1月，屠呦呦**受命**(entrusted with)领导她所在研究所的研究组，**尽管**(despite)她既没有**博士学位**(doctorate)，也没有在国外受过训练。

sentences.english: In an exhaustive search, her team combed over 2,000 folk recipes, compiled 640 prescriptions, and evaluated about 380 extracts from some 200 medicinal herbs.
sentences.chinese_source: 在一次**彻底的**(exhaustive)搜寻中，她的团队**仔细翻检了**(combed)2,000多个**民间**(folk)药方，**编纂/汇编了**(compiled)640个**处方/药方**(prescriptions)，并**评估了**(evaluated)约380种**提取物**(extracts)，它们来自200种左右的**药用的**(medicinal)**草药**(herbs)。

sentences.english: Qinghao, or sweet wormwood, showed flashes of promise, yet its results were erratic.
sentences.chinese_source: 青蒿，也就是**黄花蒿**(sweet wormwood)，展现出几丝**成功迹象**(promise)的**闪光/闪现**(flashes)，然而它的效果却**并不稳定/时好时坏的**(erratic)。

sentences.english: Seeking a clue, Tu revisited the classical texts.
sentences.chinese_source: 为了寻找**线索**(clue)，屠呦呦**重新审阅了**(revisited)**古典**(classical)文献。

sentences.english: Around AD 340, the physician Ge Hong's handbook advised taking "a handful of qinghao immersed in two litres of water".
sentences.chinese_source: 约公元340年，医师葛洪的**手册**(handbook)建议服用：“一把**浸泡在**(immersed in)两**升**(litres)水中的青蒿”。

sentences.english: Tu suspected heat during extraction was degrading a delicate component, so she switched to ether, a volatile solvent boiling at about 35 degrees Celsius.
sentences.chinese_source: 屠呦呦怀疑，**提取**(extraction)过程中的高温正在**降解/分解**(degrading)某种**脆弱的**(delicate)**成分**(component)，于是她**改用/换成了**(switched to)**乙醚**(ether)，一种**易挥发的**(volatile)**溶剂**(solvent)，沸点为约35**摄氏度**(degrees Celsius)。

sentences.english: On 4 October 1971 sample 191 completely inhibited the parasite in infected mice.
sentences.chinese_source: 1971年10月4日，第191号样品完全**抑制了**(inhibited)**受感染**(infected)小鼠体内的**寄生虫**(parasite)。

sentences.english: Efficacy in mice indicated nothing about human safety.
sentences.chinese_source: 在小鼠身上有**药效**(Efficacy)，并不能**说明**(indicated)人是否安全。

sentences.english: In July 1972, to assess its toxicity, Tu and two colleagues voluntarily took the extract.
sentences.chinese_source: 1972年7月，为了**评估**(assess)它的**毒性**(toxicity)，屠呦呦和两名同事**自愿地**(voluntarily)服下了这种提取物。

sentences.english: Thereafter, from August to October, it was administered to 21 malaria patients in Hainan, and on 8 November her team obtained pure crystals of the substance later named artemisinin.
sentences.chinese_source: **此后**(Thereafter)，从8月到10月，这种提取物**用于治疗**(administered to)21名疟疾**病人**(patients)，在海南，而在11月8日，她的团队**得到了**(obtained)这种**物质**(substance)的纯净**晶体**(crystals)，它后来被命名为青蒿素。

sentences.english: In September 2011 Tu was named a Lasker Award recipient; its jury credited the drug with saving millions.
sentences.chinese_source: 2011年9月，屠呦呦被评为拉斯克奖**得主**(recipient)；该奖的**评审团**(jury)将挽救了数百万人的功劳归功于这种药物。

sentences.english: On 5 October 2015 she won half the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, the first Chinese woman Nobel laureate.
sentences.chinese_source: 2015年10月5日，她获得了一半的诺贝尔**生理学**(Physiology)或医学奖，成为第一位中国女性诺贝尔奖**获得者**(laureate)。

sentences.english: Since 2006 WHO guidelines have endorsed artemisinin-based combination therapies against malaria's deadliest form.
sentences.chinese_source: 自2006年起，世界卫生组织的**指南**(guidelines)一直**公开支持/赞同**(endorsed)以青蒿素为基础的**联合**(combination)**疗法**(therapies)，用来对付疟疾中**最致命的**(deadliest)一种。

sentences.english: The essence of Ge Hong's line lay in the boiling it skipped.
sentences.chinese_source: 葛洪那句话的**精髓**(essence)，正在于它**略去**(skipped)的煮沸。

approved_summary: 523项目联合攻关，目标是对旧药氯喹有抗药性的疟疾；屠呦呦带队查2000多药方，试约380种提取物。
青蒿药效不稳；葛洪古方浸泡青蒿而不煮沸，启发屠呦呦怀疑高温会破坏有效成分。
改用沸点约35℃的乙醚低温提取，1971年第191号样品完全抑制小鼠疟原虫；人体安全仍待验证。
1972年，她与两名同事试服提取物，再用于21名疟疾患者，随后得到青蒿素晶体。
以青蒿素为基础的多药合用疗法获世卫推荐，挽救众多生命；屠呦呦2015年获诺奖。
